name: 44875 · Shelby, OH
findings: ZIP 44875 (Shelby) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44875 (Shelby) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44875 (Shelby) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44875 (Shelby) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
